page.layout: Top of page, full width: running title "DE ORIGINE FIDEI:" with its page reference, then a contents list in lines with page references at right. A printed rule. Then the index title in capitals and italic. Below it two columns of Scripture references with page numbers, the left column first, then the right column. FINIS centred at the foot. No margin notes.

page.notes: The Greek words in the contents list (Καταστασίς / Ἀναστασὶς) are uncertain and marked [?]. The Greek letters in the first and second lines are badly printed. The partial letters at the right edge (C, Γ, N) belong to the neighbouring page and are left out. The first column's p.35. after "Deuteron.24.v.16." may belong to the line below in the original layout; it is placed beside Deuteron. No page number is printed at the head or foot.
